note: Non-urn `ruleId` — HCP rule identifiers are urn:uuid (HCP 6.3).
Missing `ruleId` — a removal names the rule it removes.
Unknown top-level request member — HCP's remove takes no reason or other member (HCP 9.4.14).
A member in the response — HCP answers 204 No Content, so the payload is the empty object.
